items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

samples/damon/wsse: handle damon_start() failure

Patch series "samples/damon: handle damon_{start,stop}() failures".

All DAMON sample modules are not correctly handling failures from
damon_start().  Among those, mtier also has an additional problem for
handling of damon_stop() failures.  wsse and prcl also have a problem in
their damon_call() failure handling.  As a result, memory leaks, next
DAMON operation disruptions, and use-after-free can happen.  Fix those.

Note that only the damon_start() failure caused issues can reliably be
reproduced.  Reproducing those issues require the admin permission,
though.


This patch (of 6):

damon_sample_wsse_start() callers assume it will clean up resources when
it fails.  And the function does the cleanup for context buildup failures.
However, it is not doing the cleanup for damon_start() failure.  As a
result, when damon_start() fails, it leaks the memory for DAMON context. 
Free the context in case of the failure to fix the issues.

Note that the issue can reliably be reproduced because the module calls
damon_start() in the exclusive mode.  For example,

    $ sudo damo start
    $ echo $$ | sudo tee /sys/module/damon_sample_wsse/parameters/target_pid
    $ echo Y | sudo tee /sys/module/damon_sample_wsse/parameters/enabled
    $ sudo cat /proc/allocinfo | grep damon_new_ctx

Because the first command is running another DAMON instance, the third
command fails the damon_start() call because the new DAMON instance cannot
exclusively run.  And without this fix, by repeating the third and the
fourth commands above, we can show the memory consumption is only
increasing due to the leaks.  It requires the sudo permission though.

The issue was discovered [1] by Sashiko.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该 CVE 对应 Linux 内核 DAMON 采样模块补丁系列中的第 1 个补丁，主题为 samples/damon/wsse 对 damon_start() 失败的处理。整个补丁系列（共 6 个补丁）修复的问题是：所有 DAMON 采样模块都没有正确处理 damon_start() 返回的失败。其中 samples/damon/mtier 在处理 damon_stop() 失败时还存在额外缺陷，wsse 与 prcl 在 damon_call() 的失败处理上也有问题。这些缺陷可能造成内核内存泄漏、后续 DAMON 操作被破坏，甚至 use-after-free。就本 CVE 而言，damon_sample_wsse_start() 的调用方假定该函数失败时会自行清理已分配的资源；函数确实对 DAMON context 构建阶段的失败做了清理，但在 damon_start() 调用失败时没有释放已经创建的 DAMON context，从而导致该 context 的内存泄漏。修复方式是在 damon_start() 失败路径上释放 context。该问题之所以可稳定复现，是因为 wsse 模块以独占模式调用 damon_start()：当系统上已有其他 DAMON 实例在运行时，新实例无法独占启动，调用必然失败，重复触发即可观察到内存占用持续增长；但复现与触发均需要管理员（sudo）权限，因此不具备远程可利用性。描述提到该问题由 Sashiko 发现。由于仅涉及内核 samples/ 目录下的示例模块，且需要本地高权限前提，整体风险等级较低。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 属内核示例模块的资源管理缺陷：具备本地管理员权限者反复触发可造成内核 DAMON context 内存泄漏、干扰后续 DAMON 运行，极端情况下引发 use-after-free。未列入 KEV，输入数据也未标注在野利用，无法远程利用，优先级偏低。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响内核 DAMON 采样模块（samples/damon/wsse，同一系列还涉及 mtier、prcl）：damon_start() 失败时残留的 DAMON context 导致内存泄漏，并可能中断后续 DAMON 操作或产生 use-after-free。仅本地、需管理员权限，无远程攻击面。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/damon/core: handle region split failure in apply_min_nr_regions()

damon_apply_min_nr_regions() repeatedly split each region until its size
becomes small enough to meet the user-defined low limit of the number of
regions.  The loop assumes the split operation (damon_split_region_at())
will always succeed and create the new region.  But the operation could
silently fail for memory allocation failures, for example.

If such failure happens and the region was the last region, the linked
list-based next region fetching returns invalid pointer.  As a result,
invalid memory dereference and corruption could happen.  Even if the
corner case is handled, it imposes stress to the allocator by trying split
regions for other targets.  Fix the issue by breaking all the loops for
any region split failure.

This means there could be a min_nr_regions violation.  It will only rarely
happen since the allocation is arguably too small to fail.  Even if it
happens, it is only temporal.  damon_apply_min_nr_regions() will be called
again after the aggregation interval.

The user impact of the issue should be minor, since the allocation is
arguably too small to fail.  But, it could still theoretically happen, and
the consequence is very bad.

This issue was discovered [1] by Sashiko.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核内存管理子系统的 DAMON（Data Access Monitor）组件中，damon_apply_min_nr_regions() 函数存在一个缺陷。该函数会反复对每个 region 执行分裂操作，直到其大小满足用户设定的最小 region 数量下限。循环逻辑假设分裂操作 damon_split_region_at() 总会成功并创建新的 region，但该操作可能因内存分配失败等原因而静默失败。如果分裂失败恰好发生在最后一个 region 上，基于链表的 next region 获取将返回无效指针，进而导致无效内存解引用和内存破坏。即使侥幸处理了该边界情况，继续尝试为其他目标分裂 region 也会给内存分配器带来不必要的压力。修复方案是在任何 region 分裂失败时立即跳出所有相关循环。需要注意的是，该修复可能暂时导致 min_nr_regions 约束被违反，但这种情况很少见，因为分配请求很小、失败概率极低，且仅属临时性——聚合间隔过后 damon_apply_min_nr_regions() 会再次被调用。该问题由 Sashiko 发现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 内核内存管理中的无效指针解引用可导致内存破坏或内核崩溃，触发条件虽苛刻（内存分配失败），但后果严重。建议尽快打补丁，避免在启用 DAMON 的系统上留下隐患。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地攻击者若能够诱使内核分配失败，可能触发内核崩溃或内存破坏，但实际成功率低。影响启用 DAMON 的 Linux 内核版本。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

futex: Prevent rcuwait use-after-free during requeue PI

On PREEMPT_RT, FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI can trigger a KASAN report
(slab-out-of-bounds) in futex_requeue_pi_complete() invocation of
rcuwait_wake_up().

The futex_q used by futex_wait_requeue_pi() is allocated on the waiter's
stack. An early wakeup can race with a PI requeue as follows:

        waiter                          requeue task
        ------                          ------------
futex_wait_requeue_pi()
  futex_do_wait()
    schedule()
                                       futex_requeue
                                         futex_proxy_trylock_atomic()
                                           futex_requeue_pi_prepare()
                                            Q_REQUEUE_PI_NONE -> Q_REQUEUE_PI_IN_PROGRESS
* timeout/ signal wakes waiter *
  futex_requeue_pi_wakeup_sync()
   Q_REQUEUE_PI_IN_PROGRESS -> Q_REQUEUE_PI_WAIT
                                           requeue_pi_wake_futex
                                             futex_requeue_pi_complete()
                                               cmpxchg Q_REQUEUE_PI_WAIT -> Q_REQUEUE_PI_LOCKED
    rcuwait_wait_event()
      if (atomic_read(&q->requeue_state) != Q_REQUEUE_PI_WAIT)
       break /* no schedule() */

 /* q.pi_state->owner == current */
 futex_private_hash_put()
 /* return from syscall */
                                              rcuwait_wake_up(&q->requeue_wait)
                                                /* q is gone */

futex_requeue_pi_complete() publishes Q_REQUEUE_PI_LOCKED before
calling rcuwait_wake_up(). The waiter observes this state in
rcuwait_wait_event() before invoking schedule() in rcuwait_wait_event().
Here, the waiter is free leave the syscall before requeue task can
complete the wake.

To address this race skip rcuwait_wake_up() in the Q_REQUEUE_PI_LOCKED
case.
This state is only published by requeue_pi_wake_futex(), which saves
q->task before futex_requeue_pi_complete() and wakes the waiter via
wake_up_state().

This wake is intended to wake the waiter from its futex_do_wait() sleep.
If the waiter is still sleeping there, it can not get into the
Q_REQUEUE_PI_WAIT state (and require this removed wake).
Should the waiter be woken up from futex_do_wait() by other means (as in
this example) and sleep in futex_requeue_pi_wakeup_sync() then the
wake_up_state() from requeue_pi_wake_futex() will wake it, too.
Should the waiter task terminate before wake_up_state() had a chance to
wake the task then the task pointer does not become invalid because the
futex_hash_bucket::lock is held and the task pointer is RCU protected.

[bigeasy: Updated comment and commit message]

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 futex 子系统修复了一个在 PREEMPT_RT 实时内核配置下可触发的释放后使用（use-after-free）缺陷，编号 CVE-2026-90003。问题源于 FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE_PI 路径与 futex_wait_requeue_pi() 之间的竞态：等待方线程使用的 futex_q 结构体被分配在该线程自己的内核栈上，而负责 PI 重排队的线程在完成后会通过 rcuwait_wake_up() 去唤醒等待方。futex_requeue_pi_complete() 在调用 rcuwait_wake_up() 之前，会先把 q->requeue_state 从 Q_REQUEUE_PI_WAIT 更新为 Q_REQUEUE_PI_LOCKED；等待方在 rcuwait_wait_event() 中读到这一新状态后会直接跳出等待循环、不再进入 schedule()，因此它可能在被重排队线程真正执行唤醒动作之前就退出了系统调用并返回用户态，此时栈上的 futex_q 已经失效，随后到来的 rcuwait_wake_up() 访问到的是已被回收的栈内存，KASAN 报告为 slab-out-of-bounds。修复方案是在 Q_REQUEUE_PI_LOCKED 这一状态下跳过 rcuwait_wake_up() 调用。该状态仅由 requeue_pi_wake_futex() 发布，而它在调用 futex_requeue_pi_complete() 之前已经保存了 q->task，并通过 wake_up_state() 唤醒等待方：若等待方仍阻塞在 futex_do_wait() 中，它不可能进入 Q_REQUEUE_PI_WAIT，也就无需这次被移除的唤醒；若等待方因超时或信号等原因被唤醒并停留在 futex_requeue_pi_wakeup_sync()，requeue_pi_wake_futex() 的 wake_up_state() 同样能将其唤醒。即使目标任务在 wake_up_state() 生效前已经终止，由于 futex_hash_bucket::lock 仍被持有且任务指针受 RCU 保护，该指针也不会立即失效。该缺陷 CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8（AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），属于本地低权限即可尝试触发的内核内存安全类问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 在 PREEMPT_RT 实时内核上，本地低权限用户即可通过 futex PI 重排队竞态触发内核释放后使用，造成崩溃与潜在内存破坏。当前无 KEV 或已在野利用证据，但仍应尽快纳入内核补丁管理。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地低权限攻击者可触发 futex_q 栈上对象的释放后使用，导致内核崩溃 / KASAN 报错与拒绝服务，特定条件下还可能影响机密性与完整性（CVSS 7.8，C/I/A 三项均为高）。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ftrace: Take trace_array reference before accessing its ftrace_ops

The trace instance files set_ftrace_filter and set_ftrace_notrace was
updated to work with specific trace instances (trace_arrays). The issue is
that when these files are opened, there is a small race window where it
will use the ftrace_ops from the inode->private pointer to get a reference
to the trace_array and then take its reference. The problem is that the
ftrace_ops itself could be freed. If the rmdir on the instance happens at
the same time the set_ftrace_filter file is opened, the rmdir could have
also freed the ftrace_ops and referencing it will cause a use-after-free
bug and crash the kernel.

Instead, pass in the trace_array as the file private data (NULL for the
top level instance), and then pass both the trace_array and the ftrace_ops
to the ftrace_regex_open() function. If the trace_array is NULL, then it
just uses the ftrace_ops without the need to take its reference (like
normal). If the ftrace_ops is NULL, that is only the case for the top
level instance and the global_ops can be used.

This allows the trace_array to have its reference incremented before
touching the ftrace_ops that could also be freed when the instance is.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 ftrace 子系统修复了一处释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞。ftrace 的 trace 实例文件 set_ftrace_filter 与 set_ftrace_notrace 在被改造为支持针对具体 trace 实例（trace_array）操作后，其文件打开路径存在一个很小的竞态窗口：打开文件时会先从 inode->private 指针中取出 ftrace_ops，再借由它获取并增加 trace_array 的引用计数。问题在于 ftrace_ops 本身可能随 trace 实例一同被销毁——如果针对该实例执行 rmdir 的操作与打开 set_ftrace_filter 文件几乎同时发生，rmdir 可能已经释放了 ftrace_ops，随后对该结构体的访问即构成 use-after-free，可直接导致内核崩溃。修复方案改变了文件私有数据的语义：将 trace_array 作为 file 的 private data 传入（顶层实例传入 NULL），并把 trace_array 与 ftrace_ops 一并传递给 ftrace_regex_open()。当 trace_array 为 NULL 时，按原有逻辑直接使用 ftrace_ops 而无需额外取引用；当 ftrace_ops 为 NULL（仅顶层实例会出现该情况）时，回退使用 global_ops。这样即可在接触可能已被释放的 ftrace_ops 之前先对 trace_array 增加引用，从而消除该竞态条件，避免崩溃。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷属于内核本地可触发的竞态型 UAF，可造成系统崩溃乃至更严重后果，且同机低权限用户即可尝试触发（CVSS 7.8，AV:L）。ftrace 是内核通用跟踪框架，暴露面广。未列入 KEV，也无在野利用证据，但内核 UAF 应优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地未授权/低权限用户在与 trace 实例目录删除（rmdir）并发打开 set_ftrace_filter / set_ftrace_notrace 时，可能触发 ftrace_ops 的 use-after-free，导致内核崩溃（拒绝服务）；按 CVSS 向量评估，机密性、完整性与可用性影响均为高，理论上也可作为进一步本地提权的立足点。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: bpf: serialize device reference release in struct_ops destroy path

__hid_bpf_ops_destroy_device() and hid_bpf_unreg() can race on the
same registration reference, double-putting struct hid_device and
freeing it while hid_destroy_device() still uses it.  Serialize the
remove/NULL decision under hdev->bpf.prog_list_lock so exactly one
path releases each registration reference: unreg re-checks ops->hdev
under the lock and returns without putting when the destroy path
already cleared it; all put_device() calls happen after the lock is
dropped, which is safe because a concurrent unreg then observes
ops->hdev == NULL under the lock.

Background: each successful attach (hid_bpf_ops_reg) acquires one
device reference (hid_get_device()).  Two paths can release it:

- device destruction: hid_destroy_device() -> hid_bpf_destroy_device()
  -> __hid_bpf_ops_destroy_device(), which walks hdev->bpf.prog_list
  under rcu_read_lock() and drops one reference per attached program;
- BPF link release: bpf map delete (no BPF_F_LINK) synchronously calls
  st_ops->unreg() -> hid_bpf_unreg(), which drops the reference for
  its own registration.

The coordination handshake (e->hdev = NULL on the destroy side vs
"if (!hdev) return" on the unreg side) is a TOCTOU check: the two
paths run under different lock domains (rcu_read_lock vs
prog_list_lock), so a concurrent unreg can read ops->hdev as
non-NULL, block on prog_list_lock, and then proceed while the
destroy traversal executes - both paths then drop the same
reference.  The refcount reaches zero legitimately (each decrement
is individually valid), so no refcount_t saturation fires: the
device is simply freed while the transport is still inside
hid_destroy_device(), and subsequent teardown touches freed memory.

The fix serializes the remove/NULL decision under prog_list_lock on
both sides and moves the destroy-side puts outside the lock.  With
the lock held, plain reads/writes of ops->hdev are sufficient; no
READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE are added, keeping the patch minimal.

Unlocked-read safety: the unlocked read of ops->hdev at the top of
hid_bpf_unreg() cannot touch a freed device, because the unreg path
itself still holds this registration's reference (released only by
its own hid_put_device() after the lock is dropped), and a destroy
traversal that already cleared ops->hdev makes the lock-internal
re-check return early without any put.  At most one of the two
paths releases each registration reference.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Linux 内核 HID-BPF (hid_bpf) 子系统的 struct_ops 销毁路径，是一处因引用计数竞态而引发的释放后使用 (use-after-free)。背景机制是：每一次成功的 BPF 程序挂载 (hid_bpf_ops_reg) 都会通过 hid_get_device() 获取一个 hid_device 设备引用，而该引用存在两条释放路径——其一是设备销毁路径，hid_destroy_device() → hid_bpf_destroy_device() → __hid_bpf_ops_destroy_device()，它在 rcu_read_lock() 保护下遍历 hdev->bpf.prog_list，为每个已挂载程序释放一次引用；其二是 BPF link 释放路径，删除 BPF map (未使用 BPF_F_LINK) 时会同步调用 st_ops->unreg() → hid_bpf_unreg()，释放本次注册对应的引用。两条路径原本依赖一个“握手”约定来避免重复释放：销毁侧将 e->hdev 置为 NULL，注销侧检查 if (!hdev) return。但该检查属于典型 TOCTOU：两条路径运行在不同的锁域下（rcu_read_lock 与 prog_list_lock 互不相干），因此并发的 unreg 可能读到 ops->hdev 仍为非 NULL，随后阻塞在 prog_list_lock 上，待销毁遍历真正执行完之后继续推进，于是两条路径对同一个注册引用各自执行一次 put_device()。由于每一次递减在各自语义上都是“合法”的，引用计数会正常归零，refcount_t 的饱和/溢出检测不会触发预警；结果是 hid_destroy_device() 仍在继续使用该 hid_device 时对象已被释放，后续的传输层清理流程会访问已释放内存，形成 UAF。修复方案是在双方都于 hdev->bpf.prog_list_lock 保护下完成“移除 / 置 NULL”的判定：unreg 侧在锁内重新检查 ops->hdev，若销毁路径已将其清除则直接返回、不再执行 put；销毁侧的释放操作则全部移到释放锁之后执行。由于此刻 unreg 自身仍持有本次注册的引用（仅在其自身 hid_put_device() 之后才释放），锁外的 unlocked read 不会触及已释放设备；而在锁内重检后最多只有一条路径会释放每个注册引用。补丁刻意保持精简，未引入 READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8（AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），元数据中未标注已被列入 KEV 或在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本地低权限用户可在具备 BPF 权限的环境中触发内核 UAF，可能导致权限提升、信息泄露或系统崩溃 (DoS)，且引用计数归零不会触发常规防护告警，属于典型高危内核漏洞，需尽快打补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发后，hid_device 对象在 hid_destroy_device() 仍在使用的过程中被释放，造成内核堆上的释放后使用。攻击者可据此实现本地权限提升、敏感信息泄露或内核崩溃 (CVSS 7.8，机密性/完整性/可用性均为高)。利用需要本地访问与触发 HID-BPF 挂载/注销的能力 (PR:L)，通常需具备 BPF 相关权限或系统开启非特权 BPF。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: rmi: fix OOB access with undersized RMI reports

The hid-rmi driver sizes its writeReport/readReport bu...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: rmi: fix OOB access with undersized RMI reports

The hid-rmi driver sizes its writeReport/readReport buffer purely from
the report descriptor supplied by the device, with no minimum bound:

	data->input_report_size  = hid_report_len(input_report);
	data->output_report_size = hid_report_len(output_report);
	alloc_size = data->output_report_size + data->input_report_size;
	data->writeReport = devm_kzalloc(&hdev->dev, alloc_size, GFP_KERNEL);
	data->readReport = data->writeReport + data->output_report_size;

but then reads and writes fixed offsets into it.  A device declaring a
1-byte output and a 1-byte input report makes hid_report_len() return 2
for each, so alloc_size is 4, while rmi_set_page() -- reached
unconditionally at probe time through rmi_input_configured() -- stores
writeReport[4] and rmi_hid_read_block() stores writeReport[0..5].  Since
readReport lives at writeReport + output_report_size, those stores also
corrupt the window the next reply is parsed out of.

The read path is worse: the copy length comes from readReport[1], which
the device fills in and can be up to 255, and the copy starts at
&readReport[2] with no regard for input_report_size, so it runs past the
end of the allocation into adjacent slab objects.  This does not even
need a lying device -- rmi_f01_probe() issues a fixed 21-byte register
read, so any device declaring an input report smaller than 23 bytes
reads out of bounds even when it answers truthfully.  Those bytes become
the register values the RMI core acts on: rmi_f01_probe() prints them to
the kernel log as the product id and exports them through the mode 0444
sysfs attribute of the same name, and rmi_driver_set_irq_bits() sends
them back to the device as the interrupt mask, so an undersized report
descriptor leaks heap contents both to unprivileged userspace and to the
device itself.

The write path has no bound either: rmi_hid_write_block() copies an
unbounded len to &writeReport[4], and the largest caller a device can
drive at probe time is rmi_driver_set_irq_bits(), whose length is
derived from the interrupt source counts the device declares in its Page
Description Table.

Finally, the read loop cannot terminate on a zero-length reply: such a
reply copies nothing and advances neither bytes_read nor bytes_needed,
and because a reply did arrive the one second wait_event_timeout() does
not fire either, so a device answering 0 forever keeps the loop running
inside the probe worker with page_mutex held.  khungtaskd does not
notice, because every reply wakes the task.

Reject reports too small for what the driver builds -- 6 output bytes
for the write reports and 3 input bytes for the read handshake -- at
probe time, clamp the write and the read copy to the report sizes the
device declared, and treat a zero-length reply as an error.  A device
refused this way is started as an ordinary HID device, like one that
does not carry the RMI report ids at all.

RMI_DEVICE must not be left set in device_flags on that path, because
rmi_input_configured() would then run the RMI setup and reach
rmi_set_page(), which writes the writeReport buffer the refusal just
skipped allocating.  The bit can arrive set: rmi_probe() copies
id->driver_data into device_flags before the report checks, and a bind
through the new_id sysfs attribute can supply driver_data with
RMI_DEVICE (BIT(0)) set.  Strip the bit where driver_data is copied, so
RMI_DEVICE keeps meaning exactly "this probe validated the reports"; the
three jumps to start that predate this patch are covered as well.

The error path also clears RMI_READ_DATA_PENDING on its way out, because
that flag is what the wait at the top of the loop tests: leaving it set
would make every later wait_event_timeout() return immediately on the
stale reply and kill the read path for the rest of the device's life.

Clamping does not regress working hardware: the read loop already
handles

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该漏洞位于 Linux 内核的 hid-rmi 驱动（HID: rmi），已在内核主线中被修复。问题根源在于：驱动完全依据设备自带的 HID 报告描述符来计算 writeReport/readReport 缓冲区大小，且没有任何最小长度下限——分配尺寸等于输出报告长度与输入报告长度之和，readReport 指针则被放在 writeReport 之后偏移 output_report_size 的位置。然而后续代码却按固定偏移读写这块缓冲区。若设备声明的输出报告和输入报告都只有 1 字节，hid_report_len() 对两者各返回 2，总分配仅 4 字节，而探测阶段经由 rmi_input_configured() 无条件到达的 rmi_set_page() 会写入第 5 个字节，rmi_hid_read_block() 更会写入第 0 至第 5 个字节，造成堆越界写，同时破坏 readReport 起始处用于解析下一次回复的窗口。

读路径的问题更为严重：拷贝长度取自 readReport 的第二个字节，该值由设备填充、最大可达 255，而拷贝起点固定在 readReport 偏移 2 处，完全不参考 input_report_size，因此会越界读取相邻 slab 对象。这甚至不要求设备撒谎：rmi_f01_probe() 固定发起 21 字节的寄存器读，任何声明输入报告小于 23 字节的设备即便如实应答也会触发越界读。这些越界读到的字节会被当作 RMI 核心所操作的寄存器值使用——rmi_f01_probe() 将其作为产品 ID 打印进内核日志，并通过同名、权限为 0444 的 sysfs 属性导出，rmi_driver_set_irq_bits() 又把它当作中断掩码回传给设备，从而把堆内容同时泄露给非特权用户态和设备侧。

写路径同样没有边界检查：rmi_hid_write_block() 会把无界的长度值拷贝到 writeReport 偏移 4 处，探测期设备可驱动的最大调用者 rmi_driver_set_irq_bits()，其长度源自设备在 Page Description Table 中声明的中断源计数。此外，读循环无法在收到零长度回复时终止：这种回复不拷贝任何数据，bytes_read 与 bytes_needed 都不推进，而由于确实收到了回复，1 秒的 wait_event_timeout() 也不会触发，于是持续回 0 的设备会让探测工作线程在持有 page_mutex 的情况下无限循环；khungtaskd 也不会察觉，因为每次回复都会唤醒该任务。

修复措施包括：在探测阶段拒绝尺寸不足的报告（写报告至少 6 个输出字节、读握手至少 3 个输入字节），将写拷贝与读拷贝分别钳制到设备声明的报告长度，并把零长度回复判定为错误；被拒绝的设备按普通 HID 设备启动，等同于不带 RMI 报告 ID 的设备。修复还要求在该路径上清除 device_flags 中的 RMI_DEVICE 位，否则 rmi_input_configured() 仍会执行 RMI 初始化并调用 rmi_set_page()，从而写入刚刚被跳过分配的 writeReport 缓冲区；该位可能预先被置上，因为 rmi_probe() 在报告检查之前就把 id->driver_data 拷贝进 device_flags，而经由 new_id sysfs 属性进行的绑定可以提供带有 RMI_DEVICE 位的 driver_data，因此在拷贝 driver_data 处剥离该位。错误路径还需清除 RMI_READ_DATA_PENDING，因为循环顶部的等待正是检测该标志：若保持置位，之后每次 wait_event_timeout() 都会因陈旧回复立即返回，使该设备余下生命周期内的读路径失效。钳制不会对正常工作的硬件造成回归，读循环本身已能处理相应情况。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 内核 HID 子系统中的堆越界读写，相邻攻击者只需接入或模拟一个报告描述符过小的 HID 设备即可触发，无需权限与用户交互；既能把内核堆内容泄露给非特权用户态，也能造成探测线程持锁死循环，风险涵盖机密性、完整性与可用性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功的触发可导致内核堆内存越界写入（可能被用于提升权限或破坏内核稳定性）、堆内容经内核日志、sysfs 产品 ID 属性以及回传给设备的中断掩码向外泄露，并可通过零长度回复使探测工作线程在持有 page_mutex 时陷入死循环，造成拒绝服务。CVSS 3.1 评分为 8.8（高危）。

items.summary: SQL injection in ClickHouse-backed meter definitions in OpenMeter OpenMeter before v1.0.0-beta.228 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to access or modify metering event data, and potentially cause denial of service, via crafted user-controlled JSONPath values submitted to meters API.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OpenMeter 是一款开源的用量计量与计费（metering/billing）平台，其计量事件数据后端存储在 ClickHouse 中，用户可通过 meters API 提交 meter 定义（包含 JSONPath 表达式）来描述如何从事件 JSON 中抽取计量维度。CVE-2026-8462 披露的是该链路中的 SQL 注入问题：在 OpenMeter v1.0.0-beta.228 之前的版本（全平台）中，meters API 接收的用户可控 JSONPath 值未被充分校验或以参数化方式安全处理，就被拼接进由 ClickHouse 执行的查询语句里，从而使攻击者能够影响查询语义。由于该 API 端点可被远程、未认证地访问，攻击者只需构造恶意的 JSONPath 值提交给 meters API，即可读取或篡改计量事件数据（metering event data），并可能进一步导致服务不可用（拒绝服务），例如通过构造开销极大的查询拖垮 ClickHouse 后端或破坏计量数据完整性。该漏洞影响所有平台的上述版本范围，官方已在 v1.0.0-beta.228 中修复。NVD 当前未给出 CVSS 评分与 EPSS 数据，也未列入 KEV，输入数据中没有任何在野利用的标记，因此不应假设其已被利用，但考虑到未认证可达、可直接触达核心计量数据，仍应按高优先级修复。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: wacom: validate report length in wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_irq

wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_irq() receives the wire report length in `len`
but never consults it before parsing. After the report-id gate it
unconditionally calls wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_pen() and then, selected by
features.type, a fixed chain of sub-parsers, none of which receive
`len`:

	wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_pen(wacom);
	if (type == INTUOSP2_BT || type == INTUOSP2S_BT) {
		wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_touch(wacom);
		wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_pad(wacom);
		wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_battery(wacom);
	} else {
		wacom_intuos_gen3_bt_pad(wacom);
		wacom_intuos_gen3_bt_battery(wacom);
	}

Each sub-parser dereferences wacom->data at fixed offsets. The furthest
byte touched on each branch is:

  INTUOSP2_BT / INTUOSP2S_BT: wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_pad() reads data[285]
	(the touchring byte), so the report must be at least 286 bytes;
  INTUOSHT3_BT ("gen3"): wacom_intuos_gen3_bt_battery() reads data[45],
	so the report must be at least 46 bytes.

features.type is selected from the VID/PID id_table entry and
wacom_setup_device_quirks() force-registers the pen/pad/touch inputs
for that type independent of the report descriptor, so a malicious or
malfunctioning paired/spoofed Bluetooth peripheral can advertise that
VID/PID and send an undersized report that still satisfies the
data[0] == 0x80/0x81 gate. The driver then reads past the received
report and forwards the bytes to userspace via evdev (MSC_SERIAL /
ABS_MISC / ABS_WHEEL on the pen and pad input nodes), an out-of-bounds
read with a concrete userspace read-back channel, and a true
out-of-bounds read on transports whose backing buffer is sized to the
(small) report descriptor rather than a fixed-size staging buffer.

This is the same class of bug commit 2f1763f62909 ("HID: wacom: fix
out-of-bounds read in wacom_intuos_bt_irq") already hardened in the
sibling wacom_intuos_bt_irq(), which guards each report id against its
minimum length before parsing.

Guard wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_irq() the same way: before parsing, reject
reports shorter than the furthest offset the selected branch actually
dereferences, warn, and bail out. Because the whole pen/touch/pad/
battery chain runs unconditionally per branch, a single up-front check
against the maximum offset (286 bytes for INTUOSP2_BT/INTUOSP2S_BT,
46 bytes for the gen3 branch) bounds every sub-parser. Returning 0 on
a short report also skips those calls for the same malformed report,
which is the safe, conservative behavior.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 HID 子系统中 Wacom 驱动存在越界读取漏洞，已在主线修复。问题出在 wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_irq()：该函数从蓝牙传输层收到报告长度参数 len，但在通过 report-id 校验（data[0] 必须为 0x80 或 0x81）之后，完全没有检查 len，便无条件调用 wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_pen()，并按 features.type 分支执行一串固定子解析器（touch、pad、battery 或 gen3 的 pad、battery），这些子解析器都不接收 len，而是按固定偏移直接解引用 wacom->data。最远访问字节为：INTUOSP2_BT / INTUOSP2S_BT 分支中 wacom_intuos_pro2_bt_pad() 读取 data[285]（触摸环字节），因此报告至少需 286 字节；gen3（INTUOSHT3_BT）分支中 wacom_intuos_gen3_bt_battery() 读取 data[45]，至少需 46 字节。由于 features.type 由 VID/PID id_table 决定，且 wacom_setup_device_quirks() 会按该类型强制注册 pen/pad/touch 输入节点而不依赖报告描述符，攻击者只要伪造或控制一个具备相同 VID/PID 的配对蓝牙外设，就能发送仅满足 data[0] 门限的短报告，触发越界读取；读取到的字节还会经 evdev 的 MSC_SERIAL / ABS_MISC / ABS_WHEEL 通道回传到用户空间，形成可读回的信息泄露；在缓冲区按（较小的）报告描述符大小而非固定暂存区分配的传输层上，则构成真实的越界读。该漏洞与先前已修复的同类问题 commit 2f1763f62909（wacom_intuos_bt_irq 越界读）属同一类缺陷。修复方式是在解析前按所选分支实际解引用的最大偏移做前置长度校验（286 或 46 字节），不足则告警并直接返回 0，从而一次性约束全部子解析器。CVSS 3.1 评分 8.1（AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:H）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 蓝牙临近攻击面：伪造 VID/PID 的恶意或故障蓝牙 HID 外设即可触发内核越界读取，并将内核内存字节经 evdev 回传至用户空间，造成信息泄露；同时存在崩溃/拒绝服务风险。CVSS 8.1，属高危，应尽快修补。输入数据未标注在野利用或 KEV。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用需受害主机与攻击者控制的蓝牙 HID 设备配对或处于可被伪造设备接入的场景。后果包括：内核堆/缓冲区越界读取（机密性高影响）、内核字节经 evdev 事件通道泄露到用户空间、以及在按报告描述符分配缓冲的传输路径上可能引发崩溃，导致可用性受损（完整性/权限提升影响未证实）。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

dm: fix race when loading and unloading a table

If the userspace calls two concurrent table load ioctls and one of them
succeeds and the other fails, there is a race condition because
dm_setup_md_queue walks &md->table_devices without any lock. If the walk
races with dm_table_destroy -> free_devices -> dm_put_table_device, there
is access to invalid memory.

Fix this race by extending the lock over the list walk.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-89998 是 Linux 内核设备映射（device mapper, dm）子系统中的一个竞争条件漏洞。问题出现在用户空间并发调用两个表加载 ioctl 时，其中一个成功而另一个失败。具体来说，dm_setup_md_queue 函数在遍历 &md->table_devices 链表时没有任何锁保护。如果这个遍历与 dm_table_destroy -> free_devices -> dm_put_table_device 的执行路径发生竞争，就会导致访问已释放的内存（use-after-free）。攻击者可能通过本地访问触发该漏洞，导致内存破坏，进而可能实现权限提升或拒绝服务。该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8（AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），表明本地攻击者需要低权限即可利用，对机密性、完整性和可用性都有高影响。修复方案是在遍历链表时扩展锁的范围，确保在 dm_setup_md_queue 遍历 table_devices 时持有适当的锁，防止与释放路径的竞争。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用或列入 KEV 目录。受影响产品未明确提供，但所有包含该 dm 子系统的 Linux 内核版本在未打补丁前均可能受影响。建议管理员尽快应用内核更新，并限制本地不受信任用户的访问权限。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

dm: fix resume-vs-remove race

If the user issues the resume ioctl and the remove ioctl at the same
time, it may be possible that the device is resumed after it is suspended
in __dm_destroy. The result is that the table is destroyed without
calling the postsuspend method.

Dm targets expect that they may be removed only after the postsuspend
method method was called. If we break this expectation, it can cause
misbehavior in various targets. For example - in the dm-integrity target,
the reboot notifier is not unregistered, leading to use-after-free.

Fix this bug by refusing to resume if the device is being destroyed.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 device-mapper（dm）子系统存在一个竞态条件漏洞，编号为 CVE-2026-89997。当用户同时发起 resume ioctl 和 remove ioctl 请求时，可能在 __dm_destroy 流程中设备被挂起后又被恢复，导致映射表被销毁却未调用 postsuspend 方法。dm 目标（target）的预期行为是：只有在 postsuspend 方法被调用后，目标才可以被移除。一旦这个预期被破坏，各种 dm 目标都可能出现异常。例如，在 dm-integrity 目标中，reboot notifier 不会被注销，从而引发 use-after-free（UAF）问题。该漏洞的修复方案是：如果检测到设备正在被销毁，则拒绝执行恢复（resume）操作。攻击者需要本地访问权限并具备低权限，但利用成功后可以造成高机密性、高完整性和高可用性影响。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8，属于高危漏洞。目前该漏洞未被列入 CVE 的已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目录，也未见公开的在野利用报告。受影响的主要是 Linux 内核中使用 device-mapper 且启用了 dm-integrity 等目标的环境。建议用户尽快应用内核补丁，并限制本地非特权用户对 dm 设备的访问。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致内核 use-after-free，本地低权限攻击者可能借此破坏内核内存，造成系统崩溃、信息泄露或权限提升。虽然目前未发现在野利用，但风险较高，应尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可触发内核 UAF，导致系统崩溃、敏感信息泄露或本地权限提升，影响 Linux 内核 device-mapper 子系统的稳定性与安全性。

DMA_HEAP_IOCTL_ALLOC allocates a dma-buf...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

dma-buf: dma-heap: don't publish fd before copy_to_user() succeeds

DMA_HEAP_IOCTL_ALLOC allocates a dma-buf and installs an fd into the
caller's fd table via dma_buf_fd() -> fd_install() before
dma_heap_ioctl() copies the result back to userspace.  If the trailing
copy_to_user() fails, userspace never learns the fd number, but the
fd (and the underlying dma-buf reference) are already visible to
other threads in the same process and are leaked for the lifetime of
the process.

The obvious "close it on the failure path" fix is unsafe: once
fd_install() has run, another thread can already dup() the fd, send
it via SCM_RIGHTS, or close() it and let its number be reused, so a
subsequent close_fd() from the ioctl path can operate on an unrelated
file.  This was pointed out by Christian König on v1 [1].

Restructure the allocation path so that fd_install() is the last,
unfailable step of a successful ioctl:

  1. heap->ops->allocate()      creates the dma_buf.
  2. get_unused_fd_flags()      reserves an fd number in the caller's
                                fd table without publishing it, so
                                no other thread can observe it.
  3. copy_to_user()             delivers the fd number to userspace;
                                on failure the fd is returned with
                                put_unused_fd() and the dma_buf
                                reference is dropped with
                                dma_buf_put(), leaving no user-
                                visible state behind.
  4. dma_buf_fd_install()       publishes the fd and emits the
                                trace_dma_buf_fd tracepoint -- from
                                here on the ioctl cannot fail.

A new dma_buf_fd_install() helper is introduced in dma-buf.c to wrap
fd_install() together with the DMA_BUF_TRACE() call, preserving the
export tracing that dma_buf_fd() provides.  dma_heap_ioctl_allocate()
is refactored to return the struct dma_buf * directly (returning
ERR_PTR on failure) so the caller holds the dmabuf reference across
steps 3 and 4.

The failure at step 3 is easily reachable from userspace: pass a
struct dma_heap_allocation_data that lives in a page whose protection
is flipped to PROT_READ between copy_from_user() and copy_to_user()
(e.g. via mprotect()).  Before this change each such ioctl leaks one
dmabuf fd; after it, the fd table is unchanged on failure and only
/dev/dma_heap/<name> remains open.

No UAPI or heap-driver interface change.

[1] https://lore.kernel.org/dri-devel/175e98de-f414-47d7-81c1-c0fe0a8f7f62@amd.com/

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这是 Linux 内核 dma-buf / dma-heap 子系统的一个已修复缺陷。DMA_HEAP_IOCTL_ALLOC 原本的流程是:先调用 dma_buf_fd() -> fd_install() 把新建 dma-buf 的文件描述符安装进调用进程的 fd 表,然后再执行 copy_to_user() 把 fd 号回传给用户态。若尾部 copy_to_user() 失败(例如用户传入的 struct dma_heap_allocation_data 所在内存页在 copy_from_user() 与 copy_to_user() 之间被 mprotect() 改为 PROT_READ),用户态永远拿不到 fd 号,但该 fd 及其底层 dma-buf 引用已对同进程其他线程可见,并在进程整个生命周期内泄漏。修复的难点是不能在失败路径上简单关闭该 fd:fd_install() 之后其他线程可能已 dup() 它、通过 SCM_RIGHTS 传递它,或 close() 后让编号被复用,此时 ioctl 路径再 close_fd() 会误关无关文件(由 Christian König 在 v1 评审中指出)。补丁因此重排分配顺序,使 fd_install() 成为成功路径上最后一个不会失败的动作:(1) heap->ops->allocate() 创建 dma_buf;(2) get_unused_fd_flags() 仅预留 fd 编号而不发布;(3) copy_to_user() 投递 fd 号,失败则用 put_unused_fd() 归还编号、dma_buf_put() 释放引用,不留用户可见状态;(4) 新增的 dma_buf_fd_install() 完成 fd_install() 并发出 trace_dma_buf_fd 追踪点,此后 ioctl 不再可能失败。dma_buf_fd_install() 在 dma-buf.c 中封装 fd_install() 与 DMA_BUF_TRACE(),保留原有导出追踪;dma_heap_ioctl_allocate() 改为直接返回 struct dma_buf *(失败返回 ERR_PTR),使调用方在步骤 3、4 之间持有引用。补丁不改变 UAPI 或 heap 驱动接口。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本地低权限用户即可通过 mprotect() 制造的时序窗口反复触发 fd 与 dma-buf 引用泄漏,长时间运行会耗尽进程描述符与内核内存,属本地拒绝服务风险;补丁无 UAPI 变更,升级风险低。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 触发时用户态收不到 fd 号,但已发布的 fd 与 dma-buf 引用持续泄漏,反复触发可耗尽进程 fd 限额与内核内存资源;不涉及权限提升或远程代码执行,仅本地可利用。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

dma-direct: return struct page from dma_direct_alloc_from_pool()

Commit 5b138c534fda ("dma-direct: factor out a dma_direct_alloc_from_pool
helper") changed dma_direct_alloc_from_pool() to return the CPU address
from dma_alloc_from_pool(). That fits dma_direct_alloc(), but
dma_direct_alloc_pages() also uses the helper and expects a struct page *.

Fix this by making dma_direct_alloc_from_pool() return the struct page *
again, and pass the CPU address back through an out-parameter for the
dma_direct_alloc() caller.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Linux 内核的 dma-direct 子系统，具体是 dma_direct_alloc_from_pool() 辅助函数的返回值类型不一致问题。上游提交 5b138c534fda（"dma-direct: factor out a dma_direct_alloc_from_pool helper"）在把 DMA 池分配逻辑抽取成独立辅助函数时，将 dma_direct_alloc_from_pool() 的返回值改成了 dma_alloc_from_pool() 所返回的 CPU 虚拟地址（void * 语义）。这一改动对调用者 dma_direct_alloc() 是正确的，因为该路径本就需要 CPU 地址；但 dma_direct_alloc_pages() 同样调用了这个辅助函数，并且期望拿到的是 struct page *（页描述符指针）。结果是在该调用路径上，函数实际返回的 CPU 地址被当作 struct page * 使用，形成指针类型混淆：后续对 "页结构" 的字段访问会落到错误的内存偏移上，可能读取或写入非预期的内存区域。修复方式是恢复 dma_direct_alloc_from_pool() 返回 struct page *，并把 CPU 地址改由一个输出参数（out-parameter）回传给 dma_direct_alloc() 调用者，从而同时满足两类调用方的语义需求。该问题属于内核内存管理/DMA 映射层面的类型与生命周期缺陷，通常触发条件为设备驱动在特定 DMA 分配路径（如从内存池分配一致性内存）上运行时被命中。CVSS 3.1 评分为 8.8（AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），威胁等级为高危。当前元数据中未标注 KEV 列入或在野利用事实。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 内核 DMA 分配路径上的 struct page * 与 CPU 地址类型混淆，会导致页描述符字段被错误解引用，可能造成内核内存破坏、崩溃或权限提升；CVSS 8.8 属高危，且该代码路径被众多驱动共用，影响面广。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发可导致内核内存越界读写与内存破坏，表现为系统崩溃/拒绝服务（DoS），在特定条件下存在本地或相邻网络攻击者提升权限、突破内核隔离的风险（C/I/A 均为高影响）。元数据未标明已在野利用。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

dmaengine: fsl-edma: tracing: no ptr dereference during log output

The fsl edma events store a pointer to a struct fsl_edma_engine in the
ringbuffer and dereference it when a log entry is printed. At this time,
the pointer may no longer be valid.

Event injection can be used to trigger a crash:

$ cd /sys/kernel/tracing
$ echo 'value = 0' > events/fsl_edma/edma_writeb/inject
$ cat trace

The log output needs only edma->membase. Add a membase field at the end
of the event and use the new field for log output. Keep the existing
fields for backward compatibility.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Linux 内核 dmaengine 子系统的 fsl-edma 驱动追踪（tracepoint）实现中。fsl_edma 事件在写入内核 tracing 的 ring buffer 时，保存的并不是引擎结构体的字段值，而是指向 struct fsl_edma_engine 的指针；只有当用户读取 trace 文件、日志条目被格式化输出时，内核才会对这个指针执行解引用以取出所需数据（实际上只需要 edma->membase）。问题在于，从事件写入到日志输出之间存在时间窗口，期间 DMA 通道可能已被释放、驱动可能已卸载或引擎对象已回收，此时该指针不再有效，日志输出便对悬空指针解引用，构成释放后使用（use-after-free）式的无效内存访问，可导致内核崩溃（拒绝服务），在极端情况下还可能读取已释放内存中的残留数据。上游描述中给出了一条最简触发路径：进入 /sys/kernel/tracing 后，向 events/fsl_edma/edma_writeb/inject 写入注入值，再读取 trace，即可观察到崩溃，说明该缺陷可由本地用户在具备相应 tracing 权限时稳定触发。修复方案是在事件结构体末尾新增一个 membase 字段，把日志输出真正需要的基地址值随事件一起快照保存，日志打印时只使用该字段而不再解引用原指针；同时保留原有字段以维持对既有消费者（如 perf/trace 工具链）的向后兼容。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8（AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），属本地、低权限、无需交互即可触发的高危缺陷。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本地低权限用户可通过 tracing 事件注入稳定触发内核释放后使用型无效指针解引用，造成系统崩溃并可能泄露已释放内存内容。嵌入式与工业场景中大量使用 fsl-edma 的 NXP/Freescale 平台受影响，且该缺陷属于内核通用追踪机制设计问题，修复需及时跟进上游补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发可导致内核崩溃（DoS）、trace 输出中泄露已释放内存的残留数据，并可能被用于辅助更复杂的内核内存破坏利用链，影响系统可用性与机密性。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

dmaengine: dw-edma: Initialize IRQ data before requesting IRQs

dw_edma_irq_request() passes struct dw_edma_irq to request_irq() before
dw_edma_channel_setup() fills the back pointer. A shared interrupt can
therefore enter the handler with dw_irq->dw still NULL, leading to a
NULL pointer dereference.

Set the back pointer before installing each handler.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 dmaengine 子系统中，Synopsys DesignWare eDMA（dw-edma）驱动存在一处空指针解引用缺陷，编号 CVE-2026-89993。根因在驱动中断注册流程的初始化顺序：dw_edma_irq_request() 在调用 request_irq() 注册中断处理函数时，会把 struct dw_edma_irq 对象交给内核中断框架，但此时该结构体中指向父级控制器数据的反向指针 dw_irq->dw 尚未由 dw_edma_channel_setup() 填充，仍为 NULL。由于该中断可与其它设备共享，一旦中断在初始化完成前被触发并进入处理函数，处理器就会在 dw_irq->dw 为 NULL 的情况下继续执行后续访问，触发内核空指针解引用（NULL pointer dereference），典型后果是内核 oops/panic，导致系统崩溃或拒绝服务。修复方式是调整初始化次序：在安装每一个中断处理函数之前，先设置好 struct dw_edma_irq 的 dw 反向指针，确保处理函数一旦可能被调用时所需的数据结构已完整可用。该缺陷属于初始化时序/竞态类问题，触发依赖具体硬件平台、固件行为以及共享中断在探测窗口内到达的时机，通常需要本地环境或特定硬件配合，利用门槛较高，风险主要体现在可用性层面。本次元数据未给出受影响内核版本区间、受影响产品与厂商清单、CVSS 评分及 EPSS 数据，也未标记在野利用或 KEV 收录，实际影响范围需以各发行版安全公告与上游修复版本为准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 中断处理函数在数据结构未初始化完成时被触发即可解引用空指针，造成内核 oops/panic 与系统崩溃（拒绝服务）。使用 dw-edma 的嵌入式与 PCIe 平台应尽快跟进上游及发行版的修复版本。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

cpuidle: dt_idle_genpd: kfree() the original name allocation

dt_idle_pd_alloc() kasprintf()s the full node path, then points
pd->name at kbasename() of that string. dt_idle_pd_free() kfree()s
pd->name, which is no longer the start of the allocation.

Copy the basename instead.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该漏洞位于 Linux 内核 cpuidle 子系统的 dt_idle_genpd 设备树通用电源域（generic power domain）支持代码中，属于典型的内存释放（invalid free / 非法 kfree）缺陷，由内核上游补丁修复。

技术细节：在 dt_idle_pd_alloc() 中，内核先通过 kasprintf() 动态分配并格式化出一条完整的设备树节点路径字符串（形如 /cpus/cpu@0/idle-states/...），随后把 pd->name 直接指向 kbasename() 返回的结果——也就是这条完整路径字符串中间的某一位置（最后一个 '/' 之后的部分），而不再是该内存块的起始地址。问题出在对应的释放函数 dt_idle_pd_free()：它对该结构体成员执行 kfree(pd->name)，但此时 pd->name 指向的是分配块内部偏移位置，并非 malloc/kasprintf 返回的原始起始指针。对非分配起始地址的指针调用 kfree() 属于未定义行为，会破坏内核堆（slab/slub）的元数据，轻则触发内核告警、slab 校验失败或直接 panic 导致拒绝服务，重则造成堆内存损坏，在内核态被进一步利用时可能演变为权限提升或任意代码执行。

修复方案：不再让 pd->name 指向原始字符串的内部位置，而是把 basename 单独复制（例如使用 kstrdup() 另分配一份仅含 basename 的字符串），从而使释放路径中的 kfree(pd->name) 得到的是合法、完整的分配起始地址，消除内部指针释放问题。该补丁同时修正了生命周期管理的对称性：分配与释放的对象保持一致。

NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 8.4（AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），即攻击者需本地访问且无需特权与用户交互，但对机密性、完整性与可用性均判定为高影响，主要反映的是内核堆损坏潜在的可利用性与系统崩溃风险。本次结论仅基于 CVE 元数据，受影响的具体内核版本区间与发行版列表未在输入中提供，也未标记为已列入 KEV 或已在野利用。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地攻击者或无特权进程一旦触发该释放路径，可造成内核 slab 堆损坏、Oops/panic 导致系统不可用；在内核堆可被进一步操纵的情况下，存在本地权限提升与代码执行的风险。截至目前，输入数据未标明该漏洞已被武器化或在野利用。

bpf: Fix infinite loop in pcpu_freelist push with one possible CPU

__pcpu_freelist_push() can loop forever ...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

bpf: Fix infinite loop in pcpu_freelist push with one possible CPU

__pcpu_freelist_push() can loop forever when only one CPU is possible
and an NMI re-enters pcpu_freelist_push() while the interrupted context
holds that CPU's freelist lock.

After the current-CPU fast path fails, the fallback loop walks
cpu_possible_mask while skipping the current CPU. With CONFIG_SMP=n, or
when an SMP kernel is limited to one possible CPU with nr_cpus=1 or
possible_cpus=1, there are no other possible CPUs to examine. The loop
therefore makes no lock acquisition attempt and can never make progress.

The following stack was observed on a UP system:

  NMI context:
    pcpu_freelist_push
    free_htab_elem
    htab_map_delete_elem
    [perf-event BPF program]
    __perf_event_overflow
    perf_event_nmi_handler
    exc_nmi

  Interrupted context:
    __pcpu_freelist_push
    pcpu_freelist_push
    free_htab_elem
    htab_map_delete_elem
    [raw_tp/sys_enter BPF program]
    __bpf_trace_sys_enter
    do_syscall_64

raw_res_spin_lock() detects the same-CPU recursive acquisition and
returns -EDEADLK, but the subsequent fallback loop has no candidate head
on a system with one possible CPU.

Restore the extra fallback head that existed before the rqspinlock
conversion. Keep the current-CPU fast path, then try the other possible
CPUs and finally the extra head. The additional head lets a push, which
cannot fail without losing a preallocated element, make progress when the
only per-CPU head is held by the interrupted context.

Also check the extra head from the pop path so that nodes placed there
can be reused.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本 CVE 记录的是 Linux 内核 BPF 子系统中的一个已修复缺陷: 在系统仅有一个 possible CPU 的场景下, __pcpu_freelist_push() 可能陷入无限循环, 导致内核在该 CPU 上永久卡死 (soft lockup / RCU stall 级别的可用性问题)。

技术根因在于 pcpu_freelist 的多级回退加锁策略。正常路径下, 函数会先尝试获取当前 CPU 自己的 freelist 锁 (current-CPU fast path); 当该尝试失败时, 回退逻辑会遍历 cpu_possible_mask 并跳过当前 CPU, 逐个尝试其他 CPU 的锁。问题在于, 当内核编译为 CONFIG_SMP=n (单处理器内核), 或者 SMP 内核通过 nr_cpus=1 / possible_cpus=1 参数被限制到只有一个 possible CPU 时, 这份掩码中根本不存在"其他 CPU"。回退循环因此既不跳过有效目标也无法发起任何加锁尝试, 永远不会取得进展, 只能空转。

触发路径需要 NMI 重入: 中断上下文在执行 free_htab_elem() → 调用 pcpu_freelist_push() 释放哈希表元素时已持有当前 CPU 的 freelist 锁, 此时 NMI 上下文由于 perf-event BPF 程序触发的 hashtab 元素删除而再次进入 pcpu_freelist_push()。报错栈显示, NMI 侧路径为 pcpu_freelist_push → free_htab_elem → htab_map_delete_elem → perf-event BPF 程序 → __perf_event_overflow → perf_event_nmi_handler → exc_nmi; 被中断侧路径为 __pcpu_freelist_push → pcpu_freelist_push → free_htab_elem → htab_map_delete_elem → raw_tp/sys_enter BPF 程序 → __bpf_trace_sys_enter → do_syscall_64。虽然 raw_res_spin_lock() 能够检测到同 CPU 递归加锁并返回 -EDEADLK, 但在只有一个 possible CPU 的系统上, 后续回退循环没有任何候选 head 可用, 于是死循环。

修复方式是恢复 rqspinlock 改造之前存在的"额外回退 head" (extra fallback head) 机制: 保留当前 CPU 快速路径, 然后依次尝试其他 possible CPU, 最后落到这个额外 head。该额外 head 使得 push 操作——一个若失败就会丢失预分配元素、本质上不允许失败的操作——在唯一 per-CPU head 被中断上下文持有时仍能继续推进。同时, 修复也要求 pop 路径检查并使用这个额外 head, 以便放入其中的节点能够被重新回收利用, 避免新的资源泄漏或失衡。

该问题属于内核内部并发/锁回退逻辑缺陷, 主要影响单 CPU 或被人为限制到单 CPU 的内核配置。NVD 元数据未提供 CVSS 分值与 EPSS 分值, 亦未标注列入 KEV 或已在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷会导致单 CPU (或 nr_cpus=1/possible_cpus=1) 内核在特定 NMI 重入场景下永久自旋, 表现为系统完全卡死、业务不可用。虽不涉及远程代码执行或数据泄露, 但对受影响的嵌入式、虚拟机、容器宿主等单核受限环境是实打实的拒绝服务风险, 且触发与 BPF trace/perf 程序使用相关, 需要及时跟进内核补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响为本地可用性 (DoS): 在仅有一个 possible CPU 的 Linux 内核上, 若进程/NMI 上下文重入 pcpu_freelist_push, 内核会在回退循环中无限自旋, 造成 CPU 永久占用、soft lockup、RCU stall 乃至整机挂起, 需要重启恢复。未发现远程可利用路径, 也未见机密性/完整性影响。元数据未提供 CVSS 与受影响版本区间。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ceph: lock mutex in ceph_mds_check_access()

MDS session OPEN handling replaces mdsc->s_cap_auths under
mdsc->mutex, freeing the previous array and its strings.

ceph_mds_check_access() traverses this array without holding the
mutex.  A concurrent session reopen can therefore free the array while
it is being inspected, resulting in a use-after-free like this:

  Unable to handle kernel paging request at virtual address 003aaad64b2c8bb9
  [...]
  Internal error: Oops: 0000000096000004 [#1]  SMP
  Modules linked in:
  CPU: 56 UID: 2953037534 PID: 1253231 Comm: php-cgi8.4 Not tainted 6.18.45-i2-ampere #1146 NONE
  [..]
  pc : ceph_mds_check_access+0xd4/0x550
  lr : ceph_mds_check_access+0xc8/0x550
  [...]
  Call trace:
   ceph_mds_check_access+0xd4/0x550 (P)
   ceph_atomic_open+0x138/0xbe8
   path_openat+0xa24/0xfa8
   do_filp_open+0x94/0x158
   do_sys_openat2+0x88/0xf8

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Linux 内核的 Ceph 文件系统客户端代码中，具体函数为 ceph_mds_check_access()。Ceph 客户端在 MDS 会话被重新打开（session OPEN）时，会在持有 mdsc->mutex 的前提下替换 mdsc->s_cap_auths 这个授权数组，并在替换过程中释放旧的数组本体及其内部字符串。然而 ceph_mds_check_access() 在遍历该数组进行访问权限检查时并未持有同一把互斥锁，因此存在明显的并发竞态窗口：当某个线程（如打开文件路径上的 ceph_atomic_open()，最终由 do_sys_openat2/path_openat 触发）正在读取该数组内容时，另一个并发的会话重开流程可能已经把数组释放掉，从而形成释放后使用（use-after-free）。内核在访问已释放内存时会触发分页请求失败并产生 Oops，典型崩溃现场显示 pc 与 lr 均落在 ceph_mds_check_access+0xd4/0xc8 附近，调用链为 ceph_mds_check_access -> ceph_atomic_open -> path_openat -> do_filp_open -> do_sys_openat2，进程上下文多为 Web 类工作负载（如 php-cgi）。官方修复方式是在 ceph_mds_check_access() 中对 s_cap_auths 的访问加上 mdsc->mutex 保护，使检查与替换操作互斥，从而消除竞态。该问题以 CVE-2026-89990 形式被分配并随上游内核补丁修复。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 内核态 UAF 可导致整机崩溃（Oops/DoS），CVSS 3.1 评分 9.8，属 critical 级别。无需认证即可通过网络路径触发，攻击面覆盖所有挂载 CephFS 的 Linux 主机，尤其是面向不可信 MDS 或共享集群的云与容器环境。目前未列入 KEV，也无公开在野利用证据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发将造成内核释放后使用，典型后果为系统 Oops、进程被杀乃至节点宕机，形成拒绝服务；在特定内存布局下存在被进一步利用以实现权限提升或代码执行的潜在风险。受影响组件为 Linux 内核 Ceph 客户端（mount CephFS 的场景）。

ima: Check for ERR_PTR from dentry_path() in validate_hash_algo()

dentry_path() returns ERR_PTR(-ENAMETOOLO...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ima: Check for ERR_PTR from dentry_path() in validate_hash_algo()

dentry_path() returns ERR_PTR(-ENAMETOOLONG) when the path exceeds the
buffer. validate_hash_algo() passes the result straight to
integrity_audit_msg() without checking. ERR_PTR is not NULL, so
integrity_audit_message() sees a valid pointer and calls strlen() on
it, which faults:

    BUG: unable to handle page fault for address: ffffffffffffffdc
    RIP: 0010:strlen+0x30/0xa0
    Call Trace:
     audit_log_untrustedstring+0x19/0x30
     integrity_audit_message+0x366/0x4f0
     ima_inode_setxattr+0x512/0x5f0

Check for IS_ERR() and use NULL instead, which makes the audit message
skip the name= field instead of crashing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该条目是 Linux 内核 IMA（Integrity Measurement Architecture，完整性度量架构）子系统的一处缺陷修复。核心问题在于函数 validate_hash_algo() 调用 dentry_path() 获取文件路径字符串时，未对返回值做错误判定。dentry_path() 在路径长度超过所提供的缓冲区容量时不会返回 NULL，而是返回 ERR_PTR(-ENAMETOOLONG)，即一个被编码为指针的错误码（在 64 位内核上形如 0xffffffffffffffdc）。validate_hash_algo() 随后把这个返回值直接传给 integrity_audit_msg()，而下游的 integrity_audit_message() 只判断指针是否为 NULL——由于 ERR_PTR 显然不是 NULL，代码便把它当成合法的 C 字符串指针，进而调用 strlen() 逐字节扫描，访问非法地址，触发内核页错误（BUG: unable to handle page fault for address: ffffffffffffffdc，RIP: strlen+0x30）。调用栈清晰显示了传播路径：strlen → audit_log_untrustedstring → integrity_audit_message → ima_inode_setxattr。也就是说，当攻击者或本地用户在启用了 IMA 的系统上对某个 inode 设置与 IMA 相关的扩展属性（xattr），且该 inode 的路径长度超出内部缓冲区时，就会命中该错误路径并使内核在审计日志记录环节崩溃。修复方式是改用 IS_ERR() 检查返回值，并将错误情形替换为 NULL 传入，使审计消息在无法取得名称时跳过 name= 字段，而不是解引用非法指针导致崩溃。该缺陷属于内核本地拒绝服务型问题，需要本地访问权限且依赖超长路径这一特定条件，利用门槛较高，但一旦触发会造成内核 oops/崩溃，影响系统可用性与审计链完整性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: IMA 是内核完整性度量的关键组件，其审计路径崩溃会影响系统可用性与安全审计的可信度。该缺陷触发条件为本地操作为主（超长路径 + 设置 IMA 相关 xattr），不涉及远程可利用性，且未见在野利用或 KEV 收录信息，应作为常规内核加固补丁纳入版本更新与回归测试。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地用户或具备权限的进程在设置 IMA 相关扩展属性时，若目标路径超出内部缓冲区长度，将触发内核页错误并使系统崩溃（oops/DoS），中断完整性度量与审计日志记录；不涉及远程代码执行或权限提升。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

kprobes: Protect kprobe_blacklist with RCU

__within_kprobe_blacklist() traverses kprobe_blacklist without h...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

kprobes: Protect kprobe_blacklist with RCU

__within_kprobe_blacklist() traverses kprobe_blacklist without holding
kprobe_mutex. When a module is unloaded, kprobe_remove_area_blacklist()
removes blacklist entries and immediately frees them with kfree().
A concurrent call to within_kprobe_blacklist() can therefore dereference
freed memory.

Furthermore, within_kprobe_blacklist() can be called in atomic or
non-preemptible contexts where the sleeping kprobe_mutex cannot be taken.

Protect kprobe_blacklist with RCU. Use guard(rcu)() and
list_for_each_entry_rcu() for traversal, list_add_tail_rcu() for
insertions, list_del_rcu() for deletions, and kfree_rcu() to reclaim
entries safely after a grace period.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Linux 内核 kprobes 子系统中，属于并发场景下的释放后使用（Use-After-Free）问题。核心函数 __within_kprobe_blacklist() 在遍历全局 kprobe_blacklist 链表时并未持有 kprobe_mutex 互斥锁。当内核模块被卸载时，kprobe_remove_area_blacklist() 会从该链表中移除模块对应的黑名单条目，并通过 kfree() 立即释放其内存。此时若另一执行流并发调用 within_kprobe_blacklist()，就会访问到已被释放的内存，造成 UAF，进而可能引发内核内存破坏、崩溃或本地权限提升。此外，within_kprobe_blacklist() 可能在原子上下文或不可抢占上下文中被调用，这些场景下不允许睡眠，因此无法通过获取 kprobe_mutex 来解决竞态。上游修复方案为使用 RCU 机制保护 kprobe_blacklist：遍历时使用 guard(rcu)() 与 list_for_each_entry_rcu()，插入使用 list_add_tail_rcu()，删除使用 list_del_rcu()，并配合 kfree_rcu() 在宽限期后安全回收内存。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.8（AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），属本地低权限攻击者可利用的高危缺陷。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本地低权限用户可触发内核 UAF，导致内存破坏、系统崩溃或权限提升；kprobes 为内核常用调试与跟踪设施，影响面较广，需优先修复。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/huge_memory: transfer the pmd dirty bit to the folio on zap

zap_huge_pmd_folio() propagates the pmd young bit to the folio for the
file case, but not the dirty bit.  The pte path does propagate it, in
zap_present_folio_ptes() and so does the pmd split path, in
__split_huge_pmd_locked().

For most file mappings the omission is harmless, because writing to a
shared file mapping goes through page_mkwrite(), which dirties the folio. 
tmpfs is different: it has no page_mkwrite(), and vma_wants_writenotify()
is false for it, so a *read* fault on a MAP_SHARED tmpfs mapping installs
a writable pmd via do_read_fault().  do_read_fault() does not call
fault_dirty_shared_page(), so subsequent stores through that mapping set
only the hardware dirty bit in the pmd and never call folio_mark_dirty(). 
A shmem folio allocated by a fault is marked uptodate but not dirty (see
the clear: block in shmem_get_folio_gfp()), so PG_dirty is never set at
all.

Unmapping such a folio - munmap(), or exit_mmap() when the process dies -
then loses the only record that it was written, because zap_huge_pmd()
drops the pmd without transferring the dirty bit.  Reclaim afterwards sees
a clean shmem folio: the whole swap-out block in shrink_folio_list() is
inside "if (folio_test_dirty(folio))", so pageout() is skipped and the
folio falls into __remove_mapping().  There, folio_is_file_lru() is false
for a swapbacked folio, so no shadow entry is created and
__filemap_remove_folio(folio, NULL) simply empties the i_pages slot.  The
data is freed without ever being written to swap, and the next fault on
that index returns a freshly zeroed folio.

This is silent data loss for any process that keeps state in a MAP_SHARED
tmpfs segment across an unmap - for example a cache handed from one
process generation to the next through /dev/shm.  It requires the folio to
be PMD-mapped, so it only shows up once shmem THP is enabled (which is
what we did in Meta fleet and started noticing crashes); with THP off the
pte path transfers the dirty bit correctly.  It also only becomes visible
when swap is enabled, because with no swap device shmem folios (which are
on the anon LRU) are not scanned by reclaim at all, so the clean folio is
never dropped.

Reproduced on x86_64 with a tmpfs mounted huge=within_size: read-fault a
2MB-backed region, write a known pattern through the resulting mapping,
munmap, force reclaim of the cgroup, then re-map and read back.  Without
this patch the region reads back as zeros and vmstat shows zswpout 0 - the
data was discarded rather than swapped.  With this patch the region reads
back correctly and the pages are swapped out as expected.  With
huge=never, or when the first touch is a write, the test passes either
way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核修复了 mm/huge_memory 中 zap_huge_pmd_folio() 未将 pmd 脏位传递到 folio 的问题。该函数在文件型大页被解除映射时会传递 pmd 的 young 位，却遗漏 dirty 位；而 pte 路径（zap_present_folio_ptes()）与 pmd 拆分路径（__split_huge_pmd_locked()）都会正确传递，因此这是 zap 路径的疏漏。对多数文件映射影响不大，因为写共享文件映射会经 page_mkwrite() 置脏；但 tmpfs 没有 page_mkwrite()，vma_wants_writenotify() 对其也返回 false，导致对 MAP_SHARED 的 tmpfs 映射首次发生读缺页时，do_read_fault() 会安装一个可写 pmd 且不调用 fault_dirty_shared_page()。此后经由该映射的写入只在 pmd 中设置硬件脏位，从不调用 folio_mark_dirty()；而由缺页分配的 shmem folio 只被标记 uptodate、不标 dirty，PG_dirty 始终未置位。当这类 folio 被解除映射（munmap，或进程退出时的 exit_mmap）时，zap_huge_pmd() 直接丢弃 pmd 而不转移脏位，唯一的写入记录随之丢失。随后内存回收看到的是“干净”的 shmem folio：shrink_folio_list() 中整个换出逻辑都位于 folio_test_dirty() 判断之内，于是跳过 pageout()，进入 __remove_mapping()；由于 swapbacked folio 的 folio_is_file_lru() 为 false，不会创建 shadow 项，__filemap_remove_folio(folio, NULL) 直接清空 i_pages 槽位，数据在从未写入 swap 的情况下被释放，下一次访问该索引返回全新的零页。触发需同时满足三点：folio 为 PMD 映射（即启用 shmem THP）、系统启用 swap、且首次访问是读缺页。报告者在 x86_64 上以 huge=within_size 的 tmpfs 复现：读缺页 2MB 区域、写入已知模式、munmap、强制回收 cgroup 后重新映射读回，未打补丁时读出全零且 zswpout 为 0；打补丁后数据正确读回并正常换出。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷会造成静默数据丢失：跨 munmap 保存在 MAP_SHARED tmpfs（如 /dev/shm）中的状态，可能在回收时被直接释放而非换出，读回为全零且无任何报错或日志，极难排查。需 shmem THP 与 swap 同时启用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 启用 shmem THP（如 huge=within_size）并启用 swap 的 Linux 主机上，依赖 MAP_SHARED tmpfs 段跨 unmap 保存状态的进程（如通过 /dev/shm 传递的缓存）可能出现静默数据丢失，数据被清零而非写回 swap。
